req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that unsupported HTTP methods should return a 405 status code. This is crucial for ensuring that the API adheres to RESTful principles and only allows operations that are explicitly defined. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct rejection of unsupported methods, a negative case to ensure supported methods do not return 405, and a boundary case to test the edge of method support.

tests.name: Unsupported Method Rejection
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.patch('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: Supported Method Acceptance
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 200

tests.name: Boundary Method Check
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.options('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 405
